359:t_10:25.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
(That's right. A child dying before their parents is the worst way to hurt them.)

359:t_10:32.en:
$$ミコノ$$
「I'm sorry, $$シュシュ$$... I made you worry.」

359:t_10:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Her tie to $$ミカゲ$$ began with something involving $$ミコノ$$'s past life...」

359:t_10:37.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Her love for $$アマタ$$, and her guilt... Caught between those conflicting feelings, she might end up like $n...」

359:t_10:38.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So you understood what it means for $n to be the quiet type too, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

359:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If $n had completely sunk into despair, his mind would have been destroyed...」

359:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「If he'd let hope take over, he could have lived more cheerfully and carefree... But that would mean forgetting his family's deaths.」

359:t_10:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
「$n has lived without falling into despair or clinging to convenient hopes...」

359:t_10:43.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A precarious balance between hope and despair... I suppose that's why he's the quiet type.」

359:t_10:44.en:
$$スズネ$$
「But $n is trying to move beyond that.」

359:t_10:45.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You mean he is going to stop being the quiet type...? I wonder what awaits him beyond it...」

359:t_10:46.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's my job to see it through.」

359:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm well aware. Now, to celebrate that future...」

359:t_10:50.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Feel free to keep praising me.」

359:t_10:53.en:
$n
「...I've thought so for a while, but you and $$ＡＧ$$ have a pretty similar sense of humor, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

359:t_10:55.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um... it hurts my feelings if you get angry about that...」

360:t_000:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「The approaching force has been identified as $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

360:t_000:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「They're impressively loyal, rushing to cover for $$サイデリアル$$'s failure.」

360:t_000:2.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We can't just hand over the base we worked so hard to secure. We'll intercept them.」

360:t_000:3.en:
$$メラン$$
「$$ネオ・ジオン$$ is coming.」

360:t_001:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Launch each unit as soon as it's ready! Hurry!」

360:t_002:0.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「$c... I'd finally heard news of you after so long, but I never imagined you'd be here.」

360:t_002:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「That purple machine...! Is it Captain $$アンジェロ$$?!」

360:t_002:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Be careful, $$バナージ$$! I sense a nasty pressure coming from that machine!」

360:t_002:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Is it a machine that projects its pilot's aura?」

360:t_002:4.en:
$$クェス$$
「Look, Colonel! $$ギュネイ$$ is here, too!」

360:t_002:5.en:
$$ギュネイ$$
「$$シャア・アズナブル$$...! So you joined $c after all!」

360:t_002:6.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「Don't forget, $$ギュネイ$$. I command this unit.」

360:t_002:8.en:
$$アンジェロ$$
「With this $$ローゼン・ズール$$ the Colonel gave me, even a $$ガンダム$$...!」

360:t_002:9.en:
$$カヲル$$
「The Lilin fight the Lilin... This world never changes.」

360:t_002:10.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Did you sortie just to see that?」

360:t_002:13.en:
$$マリ$$
「Hey, Princess! Our enemy is $$ネオ・ジオン$$ over there.」

360:t_002:14.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...If we destroy that EVA here, we can put an end to $$ＮＥＲＶ$$'s plan once and for all...」

360:t_002:15.en:
$$アスカ$$
「That would be better for him, too...」

360:t_002:16.en:
$$マリ$$
「Oh, boy... You won't listen, huh...?」

360:t_002:21.en:
$$アムロ$$
「When $$アクシズ$$ was falling, people's hearts became one, across the divide between Earth and space...」

360:t_002:23.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But reality didn't change. People are still fighting each other like this.」

360:t_002:24.en:
$$シャア$$
「Even so, we won't despair. We believe people can someday move beyond this and go forward.」

360:t_002:25.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You're a member of $c, too. Don't give up.」

360:t_002:28.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, intercept $$ネオ・ジオン$$! We don't know their full strength, so stay alert for reinforcements!」

360:t_002:29.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Our target is the purple enemy command unit!」

360:t_002:30.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Begin the attack! Remember, losing the $$宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング$$ means losing hope!」

360:t_002:31.en:
$$シンジ$$
(Hope... There's... nothing left for me anymore...)

360:t_003:0.en:
$$レイアム$$
「I've confirmed another $$ネオ・ジオン$$ force approaching!」

360:t_004:0.en:
$$レズン$$
「I've got you, $c! That spaceship will belong to $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」

360:t_004:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「This is bad! We can't cover everything!」

360:t_004:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「If only we could activate the $$宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング$$'s defense systems...!」

360:t_006:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$ガランシェール$$! Is that Captain $$ジンネマン$$?!」

360:t_006:2.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「You're safe, $$マリーダ$$. What a relief.」

360:t_006:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Thank you for coming, $$ジンネマン$$.」

360:t_006:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Did you call the Captain here, Colonel?」

360:t_006:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「Yes. They will stay on as the $$宇宙航行母艦ソレスタルビーイング$$'s crew.」

360:t_006:6.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「$$ギルボア$$! Leave this area to the $$ガランシェール$$ and take out the enemies around us!」
